m: ह्मल् (cf. √ ह्वल्) cl. 1. P. ह्मलति, to shake, move, Dhātup. xix, 45; to go, xx, 14 (v.l.) : Caus. ह्मलयति or ह्मालयति (the former when prepositions are prefixed), Dhātup. xix, 45; 67.
a: ह्मल् — {c1c} P. (ह्मलति) 1 To go. --2 To shake, move.

s: ma cAle । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰-para॰aka॰-sew .) ma, prahmalayati । mitve'pyasya YO jvalahvalahmala ityAdinA kevalasya hrasvavikalvanAt sopasargasyEva nityaM hrasvaH । hmAlayati hmalayati । cAlaScalanam । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: calane BvA॰ pa॰ aka॰ sew । hmalati ahmAlIt । GawA॰ । prahmalayati anupasargasya bA hrasvaH ।
